name: Campingplatz Wallberg
beschreibung: Campingplatz Wallberg is located in Rottach-Egern in Austrian Tirol. The surroundings are characterized by the mountain landscape of the Wallbergmassiv and extensive natural areas. In the summer months, the surrounding hiking trails serve as a starting point for tours. In winter, the Wallberg ski area is accessible. The campsite's facilities include sanitary facilities and pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. The atmosphere at the site is quiet and geared toward a stay in nature. The location allows direct access to various alpine activities. Campingplatz Wallberg serves as a practical base for holidaymakers in Tirol.
